tagline: Inspect Gmail mailbox metadata, run bounded redacted direct reads, and use generic reverse ETL for approved Gmail mutations.

global_flags.name: credential
global_flags.summary: Credential name to use for the Gmail request.

global_flags.name: config
global_flags.summary: Connector config override as key=value. For direct reads, config userId defaults to me.

global_flags.name: limit
global_flags.summary: Maximum PM ETL records to emit; does not control Gmail page size.

global_flags.name: max-bytes
global_flags.summary: Maximum direct-read response bytes; operation metadata clamps Gmail binary/detail reads.

global_flags.name: preview
global_flags.summary: Preview a reverse-ETL write command without making a network mutation.

global_flags.name: approve
global_flags.summary: Approval token required to execute a reverse-ETL plan.

global_flags.name: confirm
global_flags.summary: Typed confirmation challenge for destructive reverse-ETL writes.
